replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I have always felt a quiet kinship with mathematics, especially when it appears in physics or the patterns of nature. It is a language that helps me make sense of the world, even if I approach it slowly and with care.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, numbers can stir a low hum of anxiety, especially when I worry about making mistakes or not understanding quickly enough. That nervousness often rises when I try to solve problems under pressure.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have tried a few AI tools to check my work and explain steps, and they were helpful when they broke things down simply. But sometimes they felt too fast or too technical, so I preferred using them as a reference rather than a teacher.
